column2: PROF. VIDEO: Mas forsa! Mas playlist, mas layer, mas super.

column1: Intro video (left on the office PC)
column2: Video di apertura (a keda riba e PC di ofisina)

column1: A show you built here, skapi, running on a laptop somewhere else tonight. Press START.
column2: Un show cu bo a traha aki, skapi, ta core awe nochi riba un laptop otro caminda. Primi START.

column1: Before it travels: check it, fix it, bundle it.
column2: Prome cu biaha: chec, drecha, pac.

column1: See CHECK in the top bar? It only appears when something is wrong. Press it.
column2: Bo ta mira CHECK riba e bara ariba? E ta aparese solamente ora algu ta malu. Click riba dje.

column1: It lists everything a show would trip over: missing files, empty cues, unreachable outputs.
column2: E ta pone na lista tur cos cu lo trompeca e show: archivo cu falta, cue bashi, output no conecta.

column1: The intro video is on another computer. Select it and delete it, or RELINK it if you have the file.
column2: E video di apertura ta riba otro computer. Cohe e i kit'e, of RELINK si bo tin e archivo serca bo.

column1: Fix it at home, where it is easy. Not at the venue, where it is not.
column2: Drecha e na cas, unda ta fasil. No na e luga, unda no ta fasil.

column1: Press BUNDLE and choose where: a USB stick, a shared folder. The show and all its media, together.
column2: Primi BUNDLE i cohe un luga: USB, un caha comparti. E show i tur su media, huntu.

column1: The copy finds its media beside it, wherever the folder goes.
column2: E copia ta haña su media banda di dje, unda cu e caha bai.

column1: Checked, fixed, bundled. On the other machine, open the bundle's show: everything is where it should be.
column2: Chekia, drecha, paca. Riba e otro mashin, habri e show paca: tur cos na su luga.

column1: A show file is only text, so it travels light. The media is the heavy part.
column2: Un archivo di show ta solamente texto, e ta biaha liviano. Loke ta pisa ta e media.

column1: An art school, skapi. One student, one picture, one critic who has seen it all. Press START.
column2: Un scol di arte, skapi. Un studiante, un portret, un critico cu a mira tur cos. Primi START.

column1: Effects change a picture; an oscillator keeps changing it. The critic only likes the second kind.
column2: Efecto ta cambia un portret; un oscillator ta sigui cambi'e. E critico ta gusta solamente e di dos tipo.

column1: A grey square on beige. I have seen this at every graduate show since 1987.
column2: Un cuadra gris riba beige. E a mir'e na tur exhibicion di graduacion for di 1987.

column1: In the inspector's EFFECTS section, + adds one. Edges is a good start: it draws the outlines.
column2: Den e parti EFFECTS di e inspector, + ta agrega un. Edges ta un bon cuminsamento: e ta pinta e liñanan.

column1: There are dozens. Every one runs on the CPU in a few milliseconds. Mostly.
column2: Tin diesnan. Cada un ta core riba e CPU den algun miliseconde. Mayoria.

column1: Take a risk! Bad art is fine. Boring art is a crime.
column2: Tuma riesgo! Arte malu ta bon. Arte aburido ta un crimen.

column1: Every control with a ~ beside it can follow an oscillator. Press one. The knob starts to breathe.
column2: Cualke control cu un ~ banda di dje por sigui un oscillator. Click riba un. E boton ta cuminsa hala rosea.

column1: A low-frequency oscillator: slow, so the eye can follow it. A quarter of a hertz is a four-second breath.
column2: Un oscillator di frecuensia abou: pocopoco, pa wowo por sigui. Un cuarto di hertz ta un rosea di cuater seconde.

column1: Now it MOVES. Okay. Okay. I'm listening.
column2: Awor e ta MOVE. Bon. Bon. Mi ta scuchando.

column1: Effects that draw a colour, like Edges' line, have a colour chip. It opens the picker: a wheel, typed names, or a colour off the screen.
column2: Efecto cu ta pinta un color, manera e liña di Edges, tin un chip di color. E ta habri e cohedo: un wiel, nomber skirbi, of un color for di pantaya.

column1: Every colour has a name somewhere. Mine is 'oscilloscope green'. Nobody else uses it.
column2: Cada color tin un nomber un caminda. Di mi ta 'berde di oscilloscope'. Ningun hende mas no ta us'e.

column1: That colour is doing something. I don't know what. I love it.
column2: E color ei ta hasi algu. Mi no sa kico. Mi ta stima e.

column1: An effect, a ~ and a colour. The critic is crying, skapi. Good crying, I think.
column2: Un efecto, un ~ i un color. E critico ta yora, skapi. Bon yoramentu, mi ta kere.

column1: Stack a few. Each has its own ~ on every knob. That is how a look becomes a performance.
column2: Pone hopi riba otro. Cada un tin su mes ~ riba cada boton. Asina un show ta parse un show.

column1: It's still a square. But it's YOUR square. Post it.
column2: Ainda un cuadra. Pero BO cuadra. Manda e.

column1: Coach Marv explains sport by drawing circles on it. Once he circled the sun. Ten minutes, skapi.
column2: Coach Marv ta splica deporte pintando sirculo riba dje. Un biaha el a pinta un sirculo rond di solo. Dies minuut, skapi.

column1: Tonight: test patterns, the video synth, and drawing on the picture. Press START.
column2: Awe nochi: portret di prueba, e synth di video, i pinta riba e portret. Primi START.

column1: Get me a picture and a pen. BOOM.
column2: Duna mi un portret i un pen. BOEM.

column1: Line up the screens BEFORE the show. Not during. I learned this in Plovdiv.
column2: Drecha e pantayanan PROME cu e show. No meimei. Mi a siña esaki na Plovdiv.

column1: Every desk needs a test pattern. PATTERN adds Pocket Test: checked against real meters.
column2: Cada mesa mester un portret di prueba. PATRON ta agrega Pocket Test: chekia cu midi di berdad.

column1: He says 'no camera needed' like it is a feature. It is a feature.
column2: E ta bisa 'no mester camara' manera ta un caracteristica. Ta un caracteristica.

column1: My favourite. SOURCE, then Video Synth: oscillators, mirrors and feedback. No camera needed.
column2: Mi faborito. FUENTE, despues Video Synth: oscillator, spiegel i feedback. No mester camara.

column1: Select it, then TAKE. Confident operators press Enter.
column2: Cohe e, despues TAKE. Operado cu confiansa ta primi Enter.

column1: That's our replay. Every replay needs a pundit.
column2: Esaki ta nos replay. Cada replay mester un comentarista.

column1: Now here's a replay. And here's a guy. And BOOM, he's in it.
column2: Ata e replay. Ata e hugado. I BOEM, e ta aden.

column1: Ink goes on top, on its own layer. Press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: E tinta ta bai ariba, riba su mes layer. Click + na fin di e tabnan di playlist.

column1: A second playlist is a layer over the first. Like a second oscillator, mixed on top.
column2: Un di dos playlist ta un layer riba e prome. Manera un di dos oscillator, mescla ariba.

column1: In the new playlist: SOURCE, then Draw. Clear everywhere you have not drawn.
column2: Den e playlist nobo: FUENTE, despues Draw. E ta transparente unda bo no a pinta.

column1: A Draw cue is transparent outside the ink, so the synth shows through.
column2: E draw cue ta transparente pafo di e tinta, p'esei e synth ta mustra.

column1: Select the Draw cue and TAKE it. Two playlists, two layers, one picture.
column2: Cohe e draw cue i TAKE. Dos playlist, dos layer, un portret.

column1: Now both are live: the synth underneath, the ink on top.
column2: Awor tur dos ta bibu: e synth bou, e tinta ariba.

column1: Press DRAW in the inspector, then draw on the programme monitor. Mouse, or a pen if you have one.
column2: Den e inspector, click DRAW, despues pinta riba e monitor di program. Cu mouse, of un pen si bo tin.

column1: A pen's pressure makes the line thicker. A mouse presses at one strength. Like me.
column2: Precion di pen ta hasi e liña diki. Un mouse semper ta primi igual. Manera ami.

column1: Circle him! No, bigger. BOOM. That's a cloud. Fine. Circle the cloud.
column2: Pinta sirculo rond di dje! No, mas grandi. BOEM. Esei ta un nubia. Ta bon. Pinta sirculo rond di e nubia.

column1: SAVE STILL keeps the drawing as a picture with a clear background, and adds it to the playlist.
column2: SAVE STILL ta warda e dibuho como un portret cu fondo transparente i agreg'e na e playlist.

column1: For next week's show. Coach Marv will want the cloud again.
column2: Pa e programa di siman cu ta bini. Coach Marv lo ke e nubia atrobe.

column1: Patterns, the synth, a layer, ink, a still. Nazdrave, skapi.
column2: Portret di prueba, e synth, un layer, tinta, un portret fiho. Nazdrave, skapi.

column1: Try Replay in the Draw section: it draws your lines back the way you drew them.
column2: Purba Replay den e parti Draw: e ta pinta bo liñanan atrobe manera bo a pinta nan.

column1: Same time next week. Bring a bigger pen. And a turducken.
column2: Siman cu ta bini mesun ora. Trese un pen mas grandi. I un plato di sopi di yuana.

column1: The Bureau of Unexplained Signals. Two agents, one photo, and it must not air. Press START.
column2: E Ofisina di Señal Sin Splicacion. Dos agente, un portret, i e no mag bai bibu. Primi START.

column1: Masks cut a picture into shapes. Tonight we cut evidence.
column2: Mask ta corta un portret na un forma. Awe nochi, nos ta corta e prueba.

column1: That's a craft, Brandt. Look at the lights. I want to believe.
column2: Ta un barcu, Brandt. Wac e lusnan. Mi ke kere.

column1: In the inspector's MASK section: mask, then 'new heart'. Any shape will do. The heart is funnier.
column2: Den e parti MASK di e inspector: mask, despues 'new heart'. Cualke forma ta bon. Un curason ta mas dibertido.

column1: The library has circles, stars, hearts. Each one is points you can move.
column2: E bibliotec tin sirculo, strea, curason. Cada un ta puntonan cu bo por move.

column1: A heart, Hollis? The Bureau redacts with black bars.
column2: Un curason, Hollis? E Ofisina ta sconde cos cu bara pretu.

column1: Set the tool to pen, then click round the saucer on the monitor. Click the first point to close it.
column2: Cambia e heramenta pa pen, despues click ront di e plato riba e monitor. Click riba e prome punto pa sera.

column1: Click for corners, drag for curves. The way the Bezier brothers intended.
column2: Click pa huki, hala pa liña curvo. Manera e rumannan Bezier tabata ke.

column1: Draw round it carefully. It might be watching.
column2: Pinta ront di dje cu cuidou. Cisas e ta wac.

column1: Invert keeps the outside and cuts the inside. The saucer goes. The sky stays.
column2: Inverti ta tene pafo i corta aden. E plato ta bai. E shelu ta keda.

column1: The same shape, the other way round. Very useful. Slightly spooky.
column2: Mesun forma, inverti. Hopi util. Un tiki spanto.

column1: Hollis, there's a heart-shaped hole in the sky.
column2: Hollis, tin un buracu cu forma di curason den shelu.

column1: Feather softens the edge, so nobody sees the cut. Press + on feather.
column2: Suavisa ta hasi e rant suave, pa ningun hende mira e cortamentu. Primi + riba feather.

column1: A hard edge says 'someone was here'. A soft one says nothing at all.
column2: Un rant duru ta bisa 'tabatin un hende aki'. Un suave no ta bisa nada.

column1: A library shape, the pen, invert and feather. The Bureau thanks you. The Bureau was never here.
column2: Un forma for di bibliotec, e pen, inverti i suavisa. E Ofisina ta gradisi bo. E Ofisina nunca no tabata aki.

column1: Masks also go on a layer, an output, or its matte: MASK ON chooses. And every control takes a ~.
column2: Mask por bai riba un layer, un output of su matte tambe: MASK ON ta cohe. I cada control ta tuma un ~.

column1: The truth is in the waveform, Hollis. Next time, the scopes.
column2: E berdad ta den e waveform, Hollis. Siguiente biaha, e scope.

column1: A lighthouse, a ghost, and a keeper who has been alone with the lamp far too long. Press START.
column2: Un faro, un spiritu, i un cuidado cu a keda su so cu e lampi muchu tempo, manera California Lighthouse. Primi START.

column1: Projection mapping: bending the picture to fit the building. Warp, blend, slices.
column2: Projection mapping: dobla e portret pa e pas riba e edifisio. Warp, blend, slice.

column1: Ye'll be wanting the ghost on the windows. Mind the lamp. The lamp is MINE.
column2: Boso ke e spiritu riba e bentananan, no? Cuidou cu e lampi. E lampi ta DI MI.

column1: MENU, then Video Outputs, then Geometry. Where an output's shape lives.
column2: MENU, despues Video Outputs, despues Geometry. E forma di e output ta biba ei.

column1: Geometry: the projector-menu word for 'what shape is the picture'.
column2: Geometry: e palabra di menu di proyector pa 'ki forma e portret tin'.

column1: Press warp edit, then drag a corner on the programme monitor. The window is not square. Neither is the keeper.
column2: Click warp edit, despues hala un huki riba e monitor di program. E bentana no ta cuadra. Ni e cuidado.

column1: A corner pin moves the four corners. Perspective keeps the lines straight, like a real window.
column2: Corner pin ta move cuater huki. Perspectiva ta tene liñanan rect, manera un bentana di berdad.

column1: LEFT! Ye call that a corner? I've seen straighter gulls.
column2: ROBES! Bo ta yama esei un huki? Mi a mira un palu di divi-divi mas rect den e bientu.

column1: Back in Geometry: edge blend, + on the left and + on the right.
column2: Bec na Geometry: edge blend, + na robes i + na drechi.

column1: Two projectors overlap; each fades its edge so the overlap is not twice as bright.
column2: Dos proyector ta crusa; cada un ta fade su rant pa e crusamentu no ta dos biaha mas cla.

column1: Geometry, SLICES, open. The Screens window is where slices are cut and placed.
column2: Geometry, SLICES, habri. E bentana Screens ta unda slice ta worde corta i pon'e.

column1: A slice is a piece of the picture, put anywhere on the output.
column2: Un slice ta un pida di e portret, pon'e cualkier caminda riba e output.

column1: In the Screens window, + SLICE three times, and drag each crop to a third of the picture.
column2: Den e bentana Screens, + SLICE tres biaha, i hala cada cortamentu pa un di tres di e portret.

column1: Three windows, three slices: left, middle and right of one picture.
column2: Tres bentana, tres slice: robes, meimei i drechi di un portret.

column1: Three windows. The lamp gets the middle one. The lamp ALWAYS gets the middle one.
column2: Tres bentana. Esun di meimei ta di e lampi. Esun di meimei SEMPER ta di e lampi.

column1: Warp, blend, slices. The keeper will finally sleep. The gulls will not.
column2: Warp, blend, slice. E cuidado lo drumi finalmente. E cocolishinan no.

column1: Slices have their own warp and mesh in the Screens window. And a ~ on the place and the turn.
column2: Slice tin nan mes warp i mesh den e bentana Screens. I un ~ riba e luga i e bira.

column1: Ye did alright, lad. Now get away from the lamp.
column2: Bo a hasi bon, mucha. Awor bai leu for di e lampi.

column1: A game show, skapi. Three contestants, one buzzer, and cues that fire from anywhere. Press START.
column2: Un show di pregunta riba television, skapi. Tres partisipante, un zumbado, i cue cu ta tira for di tur caminda. Primi START.

column1: Cue numbers, hotkeys, and GO from other machines. Like a sequencer you can play from any key.
column2: Number di cue, tecla corticu, i GO for di otro mashin. Manera un sequencer cu bo ta dal cu cualkier tecla.

column1: Welcome to the show! Let's spin that wheel!
column2: Bon bini na e show! Ban bira e wiel!

column1: Contestant 3 is selected. In the inspector's metadata, give it a cue number: 3.
column2: Partisipante 3 ta cohe. Den e metadata di e inspector, dune un number di cue: 3.

column1: Theatre numbers its cues. Q3, Q3.5, Q12A. Deckboy reads them all.
column2: Show ta numera nan cuenan. Q3, Q3.5, Q12A. Deckboy ta lesa tur.

column1: I'd like to buy a number, please.
column2: Mi ke cumpra un number, por fabor.

column1: Ctrl+G, type the number, Enter. It goes live wherever the list happens to be standing.
column2: Ctrl+G, tipea e number, Enter. E ta bai bibu, unda cu e lista ta.

column1: GOTO. The fastest way across a long list. Faster than scrolling. Much faster than me.
column2: GOTO. E caminda mas lihe den un lista largu. Mas lihe cu scroll. Hopi mas lihe cu ami.

column1: Contestant 1 is selected. In TRIGGERS, press key, then F5. That key now fires this cue.
column2: Partisipante 1 ta cohe. Den TRIGGERS, click key, despues F5. E tecla ei awor ta tira e cue aki.

column1: F1 to F10, F12, or the number pad. Each one, a buzzer.
column2: F1 te F10, F12, of e pad di number. Cada un ta un zumbado.
Cada partisipante ta haña un zumbado.

column1: Press the key. The cue fires, wherever the list is standing.
column2: Primi e tecla. E cue ta tira, unda cu e lista ta.

column1: No mouse, no list, no looking. Just the key.
column2: Sin mouse, sin lista, sin wac. Solamente e tecla.

column1: Companion, a MIDI note, an OSC message: MENU, then Network, says where each one connects.
column2: Companion, un nota MIDI, un mensahe OSC: MENU, despues Red, ta bisa unda cada un ta conecta.

column1: A Stream Deck in the next room can press GO. So can a keyboard synth. I prefer the synth.
column2: Un Stream Deck den e camber banda por primi GO. Un synth di teclado tambe. Mi ta prefera e synth.

column1: And for our viewers at home: you can play along too.
column2: I pa e publico na cas: boso tambe por hunga.

column1: Numbers, GOTO, a buzzer, and GO from anywhere. You are a game show now, skapi.
column2: Number, GOTO, zumbado, i GO for di tur caminda. Awor bo ta un show di pregunta, skapi.

column1: A cue can have a key, a MIDI note and an OSC address at once. Belt, braces and a second belt.
column2: Un cue por tin un tecla, un nota MIDI i un adres OSC tur na mesun ora. Faha, brasa, i otro faha.
Bon nochi, tur hende! Sigui bira!

column1: Channel 6 weather, skapi. A map, a presenter, and a very large lizard. Press START.
column2: Tempu riba Canal 6, skapi. Un mapa, un presentado, i un lagadishi masha grandi. Primi START.

column1: Words on screen: Lower Thirds, text, and backdrops.
column2: Palabra riba pantaya: un Lower Third, texto i fondo.

column1: I'm June O'Neil, and nothing about this forecast is normal.
column2: Ami ta June O'Neil, i nada den e pronostico aki no ta normal.

column1: Words go on their own layer: press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: Palabra ta bai riba nan mes layer: click + na fin di e tabnan di playlist.

column1: A second playlist is a layer over the map. The lizard stays underneath. Mostly.
column2: Un di dos playlist ta un layer riba e mapa. E lagadishi ta keda bou. Mayoria di tempo.

column1: Words on top. Always on top.
In the new playlist: SOURCE, then Lower Third.
column2: Den e playlist nobo: FUENTE, despues Lower Third.

column1: A name and a title, low on the screen, out of the lizard's way.
column2: Un nomber i un titulo, abou na pantaya, fuera di caminda di e lagadishi.

column1: In the inspector, title: type the presenter's name. The second line is her job.
column2: Den e inspector, title: tipea e nomber di e presentado. E di dos liña ta su trabou.

column1: Spelling counts. The audience reads it at the speed of light.
column2: Ortografia ta importante. Publico ta lesa cu velocidad di lus.

column1: Spell it right. Last week it said 'Jane O'Meal'.
column2: Skirbi'e bon. Siman pasa e tabata bisa 'Jane O'Meal'.

column1: TAKE the Lower Third. Her name slides in over the map.
column2: TAKE e Lower Third. Su nomber ta slep riba e mapa.

column1: Two layers live: the weather, and the words on top of it.
column2: Dos layer bibu: e tempo, i e palabranan ariba.

column1: Thank you. Now, about that lizard...
column2: Danki. Awor, tocante e lagadishi ei...

column1: SOURCE, then Text: a title card. Then its backdrop chip: key green, for the vision mixer to key out.
column2: FUENTE, despues Text: un carchi di titulo. Despues e chip di fondo: berde di key, pa e mixer kit'e.

column1: A backdrop fills behind the words. Key green or key blue, and the mixer does the rest.
column2: Fondo ta yena tras di e palabranan. Berde of blauw di key, e mixer ta hasi e resto.

column1: Breaking news: it's standing on the five-day forecast.
column2: Urgente: e a trapa riba e pronostico di cinco dia.

column1: A Lower Third, a name, a title card, a backdrop. The lizard has left the studio, skapi.
column2: Lower Third, nomber, carchi di titulo, fondo. E lagadishi a sali for di studio, skapi.

column1: Lower Thirds can wait, slide and leave on their own. Their section has every setting.
column2: Lower Third por warda nan mes, slep aden i slep afo. Nan parti tin tur configuracion.

column1: That's the weather. Back to you, guys. Run.
column2: Esei ta e tempo. Bec na studio. Core.

column1: A rocket built in a basement, skapi, and an inventor who wants cheese. Press START.
column2: Un raket traha den kelder, skapi, i un inventor cu ke keshi. Primi START.

column1: Stage timers: countdowns, clocks, and a presenter view for the person on stage.
column2: Timer di esenario: conta bek, orloshi, i e vista di presentado.

column1: Cheese, Grommet! The moon's made of it. We'll need a countdown.
column2: Keshi, Grommet! Luna ta traha di keshi. Nos mester conta bek.

column1: SOURCE, then Stage Timer. A clock that counts down, in big friendly numbers.
column2: FUENTE, despues Stage Timer. Un orloshi cu ta conta bek, cu number grandi i amabel.

column1: Its colours change as it runs out: white, amber, red. Like a VU meter for time.
column2: Colonan ta cambia segun tempo ta caba: blancu, ambar, cora. Manera un VU meter di tempo.

column1: Select the timer and TAKE it. The countdown starts.
column2: Cohe e timer i TAKE. E conta bek ta cuminsa.

column1: Past zero it keeps going, counting the overtime. Very honest. Slightly rude.
column2: E ta sigui despues di sero, contando e tempo di mas. Masha exacto. Un tiki malcria.

column1: Ten... nine... ooh, I do love a countdown.
column2: Dies... nuebe... ai, mi ta stima un conta bek.

column1: Something's loose! Space holds the countdown. The clock shows it is held.
column2: Algu ta los! Space ta pousa e conta. E orloshi ta mustra cu e ta pousa.

column1: A hold is not a stop. Space again, and it carries on from where it was.
column2: Pousa no ta caba. Space atrobe, i e ta sigui for di unda e tabata.

column1: MENU, Video Outputs: make an output's type PRESENTER. The person on stage gets the timer, the next cue and their notes.
column2: MENU, Video Outputs: pone e tipo di un output na PRESENTER. E hende riba esenario ta mira e timer, e siguiente cue i su notanan.

column1: A presenter view is an output like any other. Point it at the confidence monitor.
column2: E vista di presentado ta un output manera cualkier otro. Pon'e na e monitor di esenario.

column1: So the pilot can see the time. The pilot is Grommet.
column2: Pa e piloto mira e tempo. E piloto ta Grommet.

column1: A countdown, a hold, and a view for the pilot. Nazdrave, skapi. Bring crackers.
column2: Un conta, un pousa, i un vista pa e piloto. Nazdrave, skapi. Trese pan bati.

column1: Timers can also count up, or show the time of day. Their section has the lot.
column2: Timer por conta pa dilanti tambe, of mustra e ora. Nan parti tin tur cos.

column1: A grand day out, Grommet! Pass the crackers.
column2: Un dia grandi, Grommet! Pasa mi e pan bati.

column1: A magic show, skapi. A trunk, a prop, and one beat where everything changes at once. Press START.
column2: Un show di magia, skapi. Un caha, un prop, i un golpi cu ta cambia tur cos huntu. Primi START.

column1: Two playlists are two layers. TAKE ALL changes both together.
column2: Dos playlist ta dos layer. TAKE ALL ta cambia tur dos huntu.

column1: Every trick needs two things happening at once. And a rubber chicken.
column2: Cada truco mester dos cos cu ta pasa na mesun ora. I un galiña di goma.

column1: The prop goes on its own layer. Press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: E prop ta bai riba su mes layer. Click + na fin di e tabnan di playlist.

column1: Playlist 2 sits on top of playlist 1. Like a transparency on an overhead projector.
column2: Playlist 2 ta sinta riba playlist 1. Manera un transparensia riba un overhead projector.

column1: Nothing up my sleeve. Everything in my trunk.
column2: Nada den mi mangas. Tur cos den mi caha.

column1: In the new playlist, add anything: PATTERN will do. That is the prop.
column2: Den e playlist nobo, agrega cualkier cos: PATRON ta bon. Esei ta e prop.

column1: Whatever it is, it will appear the instant the trunk opens.
column2: Loke e ta, e ta aparese ora e caha habri.

column1: Is it a rubber chicken? It's always a rubber chicken.
column2: Ta un galiña di goma? Semper ta un galiña di goma.

column1: Select 'The trunk (open)' in playlist 1 and the prop in playlist 2. Then TAKE ALL: both on one beat.
column2: Cohe 'E caha (habri)' den playlist 1 i e prop den playlist 2. Despues TAKE ALL: tur dos den un golpi.

column1: One press, every playlist's selected cue. The audience never sees the seam.
column2: Un click, e cue cohe di cada playlist. E publico nunca no ta mira e cosementu.

column1: Two layers, one beat. Every playlist has its own opacity and can sit on any output. Nazdrave, skapi.
column2: Dos layer, un golpi. Cada playlist tin su mes opacity i por sinta riba cualkier output. Nazdrave, skapi.

column1: A magician never reveals. A playlist never minds being revealed.
column2: Un mago nunca no ta revela. Un playlist no tin problema cu revela.

column1: Thank you! I'm here all week! The chicken is here forever.
column2: Danki! Mi ta aki henter siman! E galiña ta aki pa semper.

column1: A cooking show, skapi. Live. Everything is on fire. Press START.
column2: Un show di cushina, skapi. Bibu. Tur cos ta sende. Primi START.

column1: BLACK hides the picture and keeps the show running. PANIC stops everything. Know which you need.
column2: BLACK ta sconde e portret i laga e show core. PANIC ta stop tur cos. Sa cua bo mester.

column1: Bork bork! Hurdy-flurdy, de kitchen is fire-a-flurdy!
column2: Bork bork! Hurdy-flurdy, e cushina ta sende-flurdy!

column1: The audience must not see this. Press BLACK, or B.
column2: E publico no mag mira esaki. Primi BLACK, of B.

column1: The picture goes. The cue keeps playing underneath, ready to come back.
column2: E portret ta bai. E cue ta toca bou, cla pa bolbe.

column1: Bork? Bork. Oh, de picture is gun.
column2: Bork? Bork. Oh, e portret a bai.

column1: The fire's out. Press B again: the picture comes back, still running.
column2: Candela paga. Primi B atrobe: e portret ta bolbe, ainda core.

column1: Nothing was lost. A mute on a mixer, for pictures.
column2: Nada no a perde. E mute riba un mixer, pa portret.

column1: Worse: MENU, System, the SAFETY card: PANIC. Everything stops, the way the panic setting says.
column2: Mas malu: MENU, Sistema, e carchi SAFETY: PANIC. Tur cos ta stop, manera e perfil di panic ta bisa.

column1: PANIC is the big red button. Use it when BLACK is not enough. Then breathe.
column2: PANIC ta e boton cora grandi. Us'e ora BLACK no ta basta. Despues hala rosea.

column1: Close MENU, select the souffle, and TAKE it. The show is back on.
column2: Sera MENU, cohe e souffle i TAKE. E show ta bolbe.

column1: After a panic, the show is still there. Pick up where you meant to be.
column2: Despues di un panic, e show ta ainda einan. Sigui for di unda bo ke.

column1: Voila! De souffle, he is risen!
BLACK to hide, PANIC to stop, TAKE to come back. You will survive any kitchen, skapi.
column2: BLACK pa sconde, PANIC pa stop, TAKE pa bolbe. Bo ta sali di cualkier cushina, skapi.

column1: The panic setting chooses what PANIC does: fade out, cut, or just the outputs.
column2: E perfil di panic ta cohe kico PANIC ta hasi: fade out, corta, of solamente e output.

column1: Presets, skapi. A whole look, remembered, and back with one button. Press START.
column2: Preset, skapi. Un vista completo, corda, i bek cu un boton. Primi START.

column1: Like the patch memory on a synth: store, then recall.
column2: Manera memoria di patch riba un synth: warda e, despues yam'e.

column1: Press DASH: buttons of your own, for anything at all.
column2: Click DASH: bo mes botonnan, pa tur cos.

column1: Ctrl+D also works. Very fast. Very professional.
column2: Ctrl+D ta traha tambe. Hopi lihe. Hopi profecional.

column1: Press +, then 'preset - a new preset from what is on now'. The button remembers this look.
column2: Click +, despues 'preset - a new preset from what is on now'. E boton ta corda e vista aki.

column1: Store. Like saving the patch before the drummer leans on the synth.
column2: Warda e. Manera warda un patch prome cu e baterista len riba e synth.

column1: Close the DASH (Esc), then select Look two and TAKE it. A different look.
column2: Sera DASH (Esc), despues cohe Vista dos i TAKE. Otro vista.

column1: Change it all. Don't worry. It remembers.
column2: Cambia tur cos. No preocupa. E ta corda.

column1: Open the DASH and press your preset button. The first look comes back.
column2: Habri DASH i click riba bo boton di preset. E prome vista ta bolbe.

column1: Recall. The patch memory, returning. Beautiful.
column2: Yama. E memoria di patch a bolbe. Dushi.

column1: A look, stored and recalled. A preset can keep cues, positions, effects, levels and routing; its button's menu chooses which.
column2: Un vista, warda i yama. Un preset por tene cue, pocion, efecto, nivel i ruta; e menu di su boton ta cohe cua.

column1: And a DASH button can run any command at all. Any. Even the exciting ones.
column2: I un boton di DASH por core cualkier orden. Cualke. Te e emocionantenan.

column1: A space-opera trailer, skapi. A narrator with a very deep voice and opinions about transitions. Press START.
column2: Trailer di un opera spasial, skapi. Un narrado cu un stem masha hundu i hopi opinion tocante transition. Primi START.

column1: A transition is how one cue becomes the next. There are far more than the crossfade.
column2: Un transition ta con un cue ta bira e otro. Tin hopi mas cu crossfade.

column1: In a galaxy of content... one operator... must choose a transition.
column2: Den un galaxia di contenido... un operado... mester cohe un transition.

column1: 'The planet' is selected. In the inspector, its transition style: choose iris.
column2: 'E planeta' ta cohe. Den e inspector, su estilo di transition: cohe iris.

column1: Pushes, wipes, iris, dip to white. Even a portal. I wrote half of them. On a Tuesday.
column2: Push, wipe, iris, dip to white. Te un portal. Mi a scirbi mitar di nan. Djamars.

column1: The planet deserves... a dramatic entrance.
column2: E planeta ta merese... un entrada dramatico.

column1: Give it a time: + on transition until it says a second or more.
column2: Dune un tempo: + riba transition te ora e bisa un seconde of mas.

column1: No time, no transition. A style needs a duration to do anything at all.
column2: Sin tempo, sin transition. E estilo mester tempo pa hasi algu.

column1: TAKE the planet. Watch it arrive.
column2: TAKE e planeta. Wac e bini.

column1: The transition belongs to the cue arriving. Each cue chooses its own entrance.
column2: E transition ta di e cue cu ta yega. Cada cue ta cohe su mes entrada.

column1: Now 'The battle': choose shatter, give it a time, and TAKE it.
column2: Awor 'E bataya': cohe shatter, dune un tempo, i TAKE.

column1: Shatter drops the old picture like a pane of glass. Please do not do this at a funeral.
column2: Shatter ta tira e portret bieu manera glas. Por fabor no us'e na un casamentu.

column1: A style, a time, and two very dramatic entrances. Nazdrave, skapi.
column2: Un estilo, un tempo, i dos entrada masha dramatico. Nazdrave, skapi.

column1: A playlist has a default style too, for every cue that does not choose its own.
column2: Un playlist tin un estilo standard tambe, pa cualkier cue cu no ta cohe su mes.

column1: Coming soon... to a desk near you.
column2: Pronto... riba un mesa serca bo.

column1: Two robot DJs, skapi. They do not talk. Their helmets do. Press START.
column2: Dos DJ robot, skapi. Nan no ta papia. Nan helmnan ta papia. Primi START.

column1: Every cue has its own chain of audio effects, and some of them break the sound on purpose.
column2: Cada cue tin su mes cadena di efecto di audio, i algun ta kibra e zonido aproposito.

column1: > HELLO. WE ARE HERE TO FIX YOUR MIX.
column2: > BON BINI. NOS A BINI DRECHA BO MIX.

column1: The beat is selected. In its AUDIO EFFECTS section, + adds one. Try the delay.
column2: Ritmo ta cohe. Den e parti AUDIO EFFECTS, + ta agrega un. Purba Delay.

column1: Delay, reverb, filters, a compressor. Amount always means 'less of this'.
column2: Delay, reverb, filter, compressor. Amount semper ta nifica 'menos di esaki'.

column1: > ONE MORE TIME. WITH ECHO. ECHO. ECHO.
column2: > UN BIAHA MAS. CU ECO. ECO. ECO.

column1: Add a second: a bend, like crush. It damages the sound the way a broken file would.
column2: Agrega un di dos: un bend, manera crush. E ta daña e zonido manera un archivo kibra.

column1: The bends are my favourite. Like a tape left in the sun. On purpose.
column2: Bend ta mi faboritonan. Manera un caset cu a keda den solo. Aproposito.
> MAS DURU. MIHO. MAS CROCANTE. MAS DURU DURU.

column1: MENU, then Audio: where each playlist's sound goes, and the patch for named outputs.
column2: MENU, despues Audio: unda e zonido di cada playlist ta bai, i e patch pa output cu nomber.

column1: Speakers, monitors, an in-ear for the drummer. The patch sends each its own.
column2: Box, monitor, in-ear pa e baterista. E patch ta manda cada un su mes.

column1: > AROUND THE MIX. AROUND THE MIX. AROUND THE MIX.
column2: > RONT DI E MIX. RONT DI E MIX. RONT DI E MIX.

column1: An effect, a bend and the patch. The robots approve, skapi. I think. Their faces are helmets.
column2: Un efecto, un bend i e patch. E robotnan ta aproba, skapi. Mi ta kere. Nan cara ta helm.

column1: Every audio effect can follow a ~ too, even Motion. Wave at the delay. It's wonderful.
column2: Cada efecto di audio por sigui un ~ tambe, te Motion. Zwai bo man pa e delay. Ta maraviyoso.

column1: > THANK YOU. GOOD NIGHT. WE ARE ROBOTS.
column2: > DANKI. BON NOCHI. NOS TA ROBOT.

column1: The Bureau again, skapi. A glow on the horizon, and two agents who disagree about it. Press START.
column2: E Ofisina atrobe, skapi. Un lus riba e horizonte, i dos agente cu no ta di acuerdo. Primi START.

column1: The scopes measure a picture: brightness, colour, levels. Numbers, not opinions.
column2: Scope ta midi e portret: claridat, color, nivel. Number, no opinion.

column1: It's them, Brandt. It's a craft. Look how it glows.
column2: Ta nan, Brandt. Ta un barcu. Wac con e ta lombra.

column1: The scopes read only what really goes out, never a preview. Turn the output on: MENU, Video Outputs, OUTPUT OFF.
column2: Scope ta lesa solamente loke ta sali di berdad, nunca un vista previo. Ensende un output: MENU, Video Outputs, OUTPUT OFF.

column1: Measuring a scaled-down preview would be measuring a photocopy. We measure the original.
column2: Midi un vista previo chiki ta manera midi un fotocopia. Nos ta midi e original.

column1: Chain of evidence, Hollis. The real signal or nothing.
column2: Cadena di prueba, Hollis. E señal di berdad of nada.

column1: Close MENU. Above the monitor, the PROGRAM button: press it until it says SCOPES or BOTH.
column2: Sera MENU. Riba e monitor, e boton PROGRAM: click te ora e bisa SCOPES of BOTH.

column1: Both shows the picture and its scopes side by side. Very civilised.
column2: BOTH ta mustra e portret i su scopenan banda di otro. Masha sivilisa.

column1: Click the waveform to make it big. Bright things sit high, dark things low, left to right as in the picture.
column2: Click riba e waveform pa hasie grandi. Cos cla ariba, scur abou, di robes pa drechi manera den e portret.

column1: The glow is that spike near the top. Very bright. Bright is not the same as alien.
column2: E lus ta e punta serca ariba. Masha cla. Cla no ta extraterestre.

column1: Look at the peak. Nothing a streetlight couldn't do.
column2: Wac e punta. Nada cu un lampi di caya no por hasi.

column1: Click it again to go back, then click the vectorscope: colour round a circle. Saturated runs to the edge.
column2: Click atrobe pa bolbe, despues click riba e vectorscope: color ront di un sirculo. Saturacion ta core pa e rant.

column1: Magenta, far out by the rim. A strong colour. Strong is not illegal. Yet.
column2: Magenta, leu pa e rant. Un color fuerte. Fuerte no ta ilegal. Ainda.

column1: It's off the chart, Brandt! Literally off the chart!
column2: E ta pafo di e grafico, Brandt! Literalmente!

column1: And false colour: red is clipped, yellow nearly. Is the glow red?
column2: I color falsu: cora ta corta, hel ta casi. E lus ta cora?

column1: Clipped means the brightest the signal can carry, and then some lost. Detail gone.
column2: Corta ta nifica e mas cla cu e señal por carga, i algu ariba di esei a perde. E detaye a bai.

column1: Red. Clipped. Not alien, Hollis. Just too bright. Case closed.
column2: Cora. Corta. No ta extraterestre, Hollis. Solamente muchu cla. Dosier sera.

column1: Waveform, vectorscope, false colour. The scopes settled it, skapi. The agents did not.
column2: Waveform, vectorscope, color falsu. E scopenan a disidi, skapi. No e agentenan.

column1: SCOPES SOURCE reads any output, and the matrix can be 709 or 2020. For the curious.
column2: SCOPES SOURCE ta lesa cualkier output, i e matris por ta 709 of 2020. Pa e curioso.

column1: Too bright for a streetlight, Brandt. Too bright for anything. ...I want to believe.
column2: Muchu cla pa un lampi di caya, Brandt. Muchu cla pa tur cos. ...Mi ke kere.

column1: Pictures that leave by cable or network, skapi, not only a window on a screen. Press START.
column2: Portret cu ta sali via cabel of via red, skapi, no solamente un bentana riba pantaya. Primi START.

column1: NDI over the network, SDI from a DeckLink card, ST 2110 for broadcast plants.
column2: NDI riba e red, SDI for di un carchi DeckLink, ST 2110 pa sentro di transmicion.

column1: MENU, Video Outputs, then Devices: every way an output can leave this computer.
column2: MENU, Video Outputs, despues Aparatonan: cada caminda cu un output por sali for di e computer aki.

column1: Each one says whether this machine can do it, and what it needs if not.
column2: Cada un ta bisa si e mashin aki por, i si no, kico e mester.

column1: If this computer has NDI, switch NDI SENDING on: the picture is on the network. If not, SHOW ME moves on.
column2: Si e computer aki tin NDI, cende NDI SENDING: e portret ta riba e red. Si no, SHOW ME ta sigui.

column1: NDI finds itself on the network. No cables, only a good switch and patience.
column2: NDI ta haña su mes riba e red. Sin cabel, solamente un bon switch i pasenshi.

column1: The output's own page has the rest: a DeckLink card's SDI, ST 2110 with NMOS, Spout and Syphon.
column2: E pagina di output tin e otronan: SDI di un carchi DeckLink, ST 2110 cu NMOS, Spout i Syphon.

column1: Every one is just an output. The show does not know or care how it leaves.
column2: Cada un ta solamente un output. E show no sa i no ta importa con e ta sali.

column1: The bridge of the starship Cathode, skapi. Four feeds, one main viewer, one mystery. Press START.
column2: E puente di e barcu spasial Cathode, skapi. Cuater feed, un pantaya prinsipal, un misterio. Primi START.

column1: The multiview shows every playlist at once. Like a wall of oscilloscopes, but in space.
column2: Multiview ta mustra tur playlist na mesun ora. Manera un muraya di oscilloscope, pero den spasio.

column1: Frequencies open, Captain. All of them. That's the problem.
column2: Tur frecuensia ta habri, capitan. Tur. Esei ta e problema.

column1: MULTI, above the monitor: every playlist in its own window.
column2: MULTI, riba e monitor: cada playlist den su mes bentana.

column1: One window per playlist, the programme first.
column2: Un bentana pa cada playlist, program prome.

column1: Jinkys! Four feeds. And one of them has a monster in it.
column2: Jinkys! Cuater feed. I den un di nan tin un monster.

column1: Add a window (+), then its ... menu: make it show NEXT. What goes live when you press TAKE.
column2: Agrega un bentana (+), despues su menu ...: mustra NEXT. Loke ta bai bibu ora bo primi TAKE.

column1: Every window has a ... button. It chooses what that window shows.
column2: Cada bentana tin un boton .... E ta cohe kico e bentana ei ta mustra.

column1: I need to see who's calling before they reach the main viewer.
column2: Mi mester mira ken ta yama prome cu e yega e pantaya prinsipal.

column1: And one more window, showing the clock. Operators who watch a clock are never late. Mostly.
column2: I un otro bentana, cu ta mustra e orloshi. Operado cu ta wac e orloshi nunca no ta lat. Mayoria.

column1: Time of day, big. Stardates are just very long timecode.
column2: Ora di dia, grandi. Stardate ta solamente un timecode masha largu.

column1: The monster only shows up at midnight. We're going to need a clock.
column2: E monster ta aparese solamente mei nochi. Nos mester un orloshi.

column1: Any window's ... menu, then a layout: one big, the rest small.
column2: E menu ... di cualkier bentana, despues layout: un grandi, e restu chiki.

column1: The big window is window one. Usually the programme. Usually.
column2: E bentana grandi ta bentana un. Normalmente program. Normalmente.

column1: Main viewer big. The captain likes it big.
column2: Pantaya prinsipal, grandi. E capitan ta gusta grandi.

column1: Select Deck 3 in playlist 3 and TAKE. Watch its window.
column2: Cohe Cubierta 3 den playlist 3 i TAKE. Wac su bentana.

column1: The red border is TALLY: the window that is on air. On screen, as they say on starships.
column2: E marco cora ta TALLY: e bentana cu ta bibu. Riba pantaya, manera nan ta bisa riba barcu.

column1: There! Feed three! Put it on screen!
column2: Einan! Feed tres! Pon'e riba pantaya!

column1: Windows, the ... menu, NEXT, the clock, a layout, tally. Mystery solved, skapi.
column2: Bentana, e menu ..., NEXT, orloshi, layout, tally. Misterio resolvi, skapi.

column1: A window can also show an output, with its warp and slices. Handy when it's a lighthouse.
column2: Un bentana por mustra un output tambe, cu su warp i slicenan. Util ora ta un proyector.

column1: And the monster was... the ship's cook, all along. Jinkys.
column2: I e monster tabata... e cushinero di e barcu, tur e tempo. Jinkys.

column1: finish or leave the lesson you are in first
column2: caba of sali for di e les cu bo ta aden prome
sali for di Bug Swat prome

column1: Psst. It's me, the desk. I'll be watching. Supportively.
column2: Pst. Ta ami, e mesa. Mi ta wac. Pa sostene.

column1: Hi! I'm the one doing all of this, by the way.
column2: Ayo! Di berdad, ami ta esun cu ta hasi tur esaki.

column1: Ctrl+D opens the DASH. I'm just saying.
column2: Ctrl+D ta habri DASH. Mi ta bisa so.

column1: Nearly there. I can feel it in my pixels.
column2: Casi. Mi ta sinti e den mi pixelnan.

column1: You're good at this. I can tell. I'm the one doing it.
column2: Bo ta bon na esaki. Mi ta mira. Di berdad.

column1: Every click, I heard. Every single one.
column2: Cada click, mi a tende. Cada un.

column1: The glowing one. I can see it from here. It's glowing for you.
column2: Esun cu ta lombra. Mi ta mir'e for di aki. E ta lombra pa bo.

column1: lesson paused - MENU > LESSONS picks up where you left off
column2: les pousa - MENU > LESSONS ta sigui for di unda bo a laga

column1: PROF. VIDEO:  The signal: what the picture is made of, and how to bend it. Pick a lesson.
column2: PROF. VIDEO:  E señal: di kico un portret ta traha, i con e ta worde dobla. Cohe un les.

column1: DR. PIXEL:  Running the show, skapi. Fast hands, calm face. Pick a lesson.
column2: DR. PIXEL:  Core e show, skapi. Man lihe, cara trankilo. Cohe un les.

column1: LESSONS  -  PART TWO  -  WHO DO YOU FOLLOW?
column2: LES  -  PARTI DOS  -  KEN BO TA SIGUI?

column1: finish or leave LEARN THE BASICS first
column2: caba of sali for di LEARN THE BASICS prome

column1: bug swat: Esc leaves, and your show comes back as it was
column2: bug swat: Esc ta sali, i bo show ta bolbe manera e tabata

column1: bug swat: your show is back. Motion's controls are in Settings > Audio
column2: bug swat: bo show a bolbe. E controlnan di Motion ta den Configuracion > Audio

column1: Bugs are crawling to the cue list! Swat them by waving at your camera. First, Motion: in MOTION CONTROL turn it ON and choose what it READS.
column2: Bishitu ta bini pa e lista di cue! Zwai bo man pa e camara pa mata nan. Prome Motion: pon'e ON den MOTION CONTROL i cohe kico e ta lesa (READS).

column1: This one is NullPointer. Hollow, points at nothing. A finger goes straight through. Use the whole hand, skapi.
column2: Esaki ta NullPointer. E ta bashi, e no ta mustra na nada. Un dede ta pasa dor di dje. Usa henter bo man, skapi.

column1: Wave like you are hailing a cab! A small, polite cab. Not the buttons. The cab.
column2: Zwai manera bo ta para un taxi! Un taxi chiki i educau. No un boton. Un taxi.

column1: Race Condition: twins, each sure it got there first. One reading cannot tell your hands apart, so drag two ZONES on the Motion picture, one each side.
column2: Race Condition: morochi, cada un sigur cu e a yega prome. Un lesamentu no por separa bo mannan, p'esei hala dos ZONES riba e portret di Motion, un pa cada banda.

column1: Hit both together. Hit one, and they swap. Like my cousins at a wedding.
column2: Dal tur dos na mesun ora. Dal un, nan ta cambia luga. Manera mi primunan na un casamentu.

column1: One hand each side. Together! Together!
column2: Un man pa cada banda. Huntu! Huntu!

column1: Off By One. The bug is not the face, it is the tiny extra segment, and a little wiggle needs a finer reading. Turn SENSITIVITY down to 5%.
column2: Off By One. E bishitu no ta e cara, ta e pida chiki di mas, i un movementu chiki mester un lesamentu mas fini. Baha SENSITIVITY te 5%.

column1: Lower number, finer reading. Yes, I also think it is backwards.
column2: Number mas abou, lesamentu mas fini. Si, ami tambe ta kere cu ta al reves.

column1: Not the face. The little one on the end. Wiggle a finger.
column2: No e cara. E chiki na fin. Move un dede.

column1: Memory Leak. It only lets go while the reading stays up. Make FALL longer, 1.5 seconds or more, so your sweeps join up into one.
column2: Memory Leac. E ta laga solamente ora e lesamentu keda haltu. Hasi FALL mas largu, 1.5 seconde of mas, pa bo golpinan bira un.

column1: Slow and steady, skapi. Like paying back a loan.
column2: Pocopoco i firme, skapi. Manera paga un debe.

column1: Sweep, and sweep again. Let the fall carry you between.
column2: Bari, i bari atrobe. Laga e baha tene bo meimei.

column1: The Heisenbug! It fades whenever you move. Put a tone cue's pitch on Motion X and follow it by ear: the ticking speeds up as you close in.
column2: Heisenbug! E ta disparse cada biaha bo move. Pone e altura di un cue di zonido riba Motion X i sigui e cu orea: e tictic ta bira mas lihe ora bo ta serca.

column1: SHOW ME makes the tone for you. High is right. Low is left. Stand still and it comes back.
column2: SHOW ME ta traha e zonido pa bo. Haltu ta drechi. Abou ta robes. Para keto i e ta bolbe.

column1: Follow it. Listen. Faster ticking, closer bug.
column2: Sigui e. Scucha. Tictic mas lihe, bishitu mas serca.

column1: Closed as fixed. No regressions. Probably.
column2: Sera como drecha. Sin regrecion. Cisas.

column1: One reached the cue list. It has filed a bug report about you.
column2: Un a yega e lista di cue. E a hasi un reporte di eror tocante bo.

column1: Skapi. It is a handheld. You do not press it. You wave at it.
column2: Skapi. Esaki ta un aparato di man. Bo no ta primi e. Bo ta zwai bo man pa e.

column1: The buttons are for menus. The bugs are for flailing.
column2: Boton ta pa menu. Bishitu ta pa zwai brasa.

column1: The D-pad is decorative. Like my diploma.
column2: E D-pad ta decoracion. Manera mi diploma.

column1: In 1989 we also pressed the buttons. Then we discovered waving. Never looked back.
column2: Na 1989 nos tambe tabata primi boton. Despues nos a descubri zwai. Nunca nos no a wac atras.

column1: Pressing harder does not help. The bugs cannot feel buttons. Only arms.
column2: Primi mas duru no ta yuda. Bishitu no ta sinti boton. Solamente brasa.

column1: It's called a handheld because your hands are held... up. In the air. Waving.
column2: Nan ta yam'e aparato di man pasobra mannan ta... subi. Den aire. Ta zwai.

column1: The mouse? You are swatting bugs with a MOUSE? In Bulgaria the mouse would be on the bugs' side.
column2: Un mouse? Bo ta mata bishitu cu un MOUSE? Na Bulgaria e mouse lo ta riba e banda di e bishitunan.

column1: Lovely clicking. Very crisp. The camera saw none of it.

column2: Si notanan MIDI cu ta drenta ta toca e synth aki of ta cuminsa cues manera semper.

column1: A note number, or type LEARN and play it. Notes no cue claims still go to cue N+1
column2: Un number di nota, of tipa LEARN y toc'e. Notanan cu ningun cue ta reclama ta bai na cue N+1

column1: A plain stereo pair. Click to open the matrix, starting from exactly this routing
column2: Un pareja stereo simpel. Click pa habri e matrix, cuminsando exacto for di e ruta aki

column1: Folding is what turns an arbitrary pattern into something that reads as designed.
column2: Dobla ta loke ta bira cualkier patron den algo cu ta parce diseña.

column1: Channel=level, comma separated. Ranges too: 1=255, 10-14=64. Channels count from 1
column2: Canal=nivel, separa cu comma. Rango tambe: 1=255, 10-14=64. Canalnan ta conta for di 1

column1: Moves every selected cue's trim by the same dB; typing a value sets them all to it
column2: Ta move trim di tur cue scogi cu e mesun dB; tipa un balor ta pone nan tur na dje

column1: Bends the carrier's PITCH rather than mixing with it. This is what makes FDS growl.
column2: Ta dobla e TOON di e portador en bes di mezcla cu ne. Esaki ta pone FDS gruña.

column1: Half way through LEARN THE BASICS. Press L and we pick up where you stopped, skapi.
column2: Mitar di caminda den SIÑA E BASE. Primi L y nos ta sigui unda bo a para, skapi.

column1: Render as a character grid with a 16-colour indexed palette, rather than as pixels.
column2: Render como un rooster di letter cu un paleta indexa di 16 color, en bes di pixel.

column1: Which MIDI output this file plays to; step past the end for the first one available
column2: Na cua salida MIDI e archivo aki ta toca; pasa e final pa e prome disponibel

column1: An IPv4 address, or 255.255.255.255 for the universe's multicast group (239.255.x.y)
column2: Un adres IPv4, of 255.255.255.255 pa e grupo multicast di e universo (239.255.x.y)

column1: Click a cell to walk it: off, full, -3, -6, -12. This row turns the matrix off again
column2: Click riba un cel pa cambi'e: paga, yen, -3, -6, -12. E liña aki ta paga e matrix atrobe

column1: How long each phrase stays before it moves. Zero hides them without losing the list.
column2: Cuanto tempo cada frase ta keda promer cu e move. Cero ta skonde nan sin perde e lista.

column1: How long it takes to fall away after the attack. Only audible when retrigger is set.
column2: Cuanto tempo e ta tuma pa baha despues di e ataque. Ta zona so ora retrigger ta encende.

column1: Off, from start (next cue fires when this one starts) or from end (when it finishes)
column2: Paga, for di cuminsamento (siguiente cue ta cuminsa ora esaki cuminsa) of for di final (ora e caba)

column1: Height of one line as a percent of the raster, so a card reads the same on any screen
column2: Altura di un liña como porcentahe di raster, pa un karta lesa igual riba cualkier pantaya

column1: Set slot source as media:/path, browser:url, window:name, camera:name, or syphon:name
column2: Pone fuente di slot como media:/caminda, browser:url, window:nomber, camera:nomber, of syphon:nomber

column1: Short LFSR mode. The period is brief enough to read as pitched metal rather than hiss.
column2: Modo LFSR cortico. E periodo ta cortico basta pa zona manera metal afina en bes di sisa.

column1: White, warm, red, amber, green, cyan, blue, magenta. ~ moves it round the colour wheel
column2: Blanco, cayente, cora, amber, berde, cyan, blauw, magenta. ~ ta move'e rond di e wiel di color

column1: Re-strike the envelope this often. Hold sustains one note, which is what a drone wants.
column2: Bati e envelope atrobe asina tantu. Hold ta tene un nota, loke un drone ta kier.

column1: Diamond is the hard-edged Atari Video Music lattice; rings tunnel well with feedback zoom.
column2: Diamond ta e rooster di randa duro di Atari Video Music; ringnan ta traha bon tunel cu zoom di feedback.

column1: Rock or spin. Depth 1 is half a turn either way; a saw at depth 1 turns it all the way round
column2: Slinger of draai. Profundidad 1 ta mitar di un buelta cada banda; un saw na 1 ta draai'e henter buelta

column1: DECK playback level (live, not saved with the cue) - per-cue trim is gain in the AUDIO section
column2: Nivel di toca di DECK (en bibo, no warda cu e cue) - trim pa cada cue ta ganancia den seccion AUDIO

column1: Still, fade in, typewriter, scroll up, crawl or pulse -- all driven by the cue's own transport
column2: Keto, drenta, mashin di skirbi, rol ariba, crawl of pulso -- tur ta core pa e transporte di e cue mes

column1: Fields per rendered frame. 1 is one for one, 0.5 holds each field for two frames, 0 freezes it.
column2: Campo pa imagen. 1 ta un pa un, 0.5 ta tene cada campo dos imagen, 0 ta frees'e.

column1: What this cue shows while it plays: waveform, scope, Lissajous, spectrum, meters or a name card
column2: Loke e cue aki ta mustra mientras e ta toca: forma di ola, scope, Lissajous, spectro, meter of un karta di nomber

column1: 0 picks tiles by brightness so the picture reads. 1 picks at random so the grid becomes texture.
column2: 0 ta scoge tegel pa brio pa e imagen lesa. 1 ta scoge na casualidad pa e rooster bira textura.

column1: How far it travels, in semitones. Up reads as arrival, down as departure, zero is a struck note.
column2: Cuanto e ta biaha, den semitono. Ariba ta zona manera yegada, abou manera salida, cero ta un nota bati.

column1: An IPv4 address. Names are not resolved: a DNS lookup is a blocking call and GO must not make one
column2: Un adres IPv4. Nombernan no ta wordo resolve: un busqueda DNS ta bloka y GO no mag hasi esei

column1: Tile width in pixels. Must match the sheet's grid or the slices land across neighbouring sprites.
column2: Ancho di tegel den pixel. Mester cuadra cu rooster di e blachi of e pidanan ta cay riba sprites banda.

column1: Alternating mirrors by cell position, which reads as pattern where random flipping reads as noise.
column2: Spiegel alterna pa posicion di cel, cu ta lesa como patron unda cambio na casualidad ta lesa como ruido.

column1: 0 welds them to their cell, which reads as engraved. Above it they re-roll, which reads as boiling.
column2: 0 ta solda nan na nan cel, cu ta lesa como grabá. Riba esei nan ta wordo scogi atrobe, cu ta lesa como hirbiendo.

column1: MONO L plays the left input in both speakers: mic 1 on most interfaces. STEREO is for a line source.
column2: MONO L ta toca entrada robes den tur dos boxi: mic 1 riba mayoria interfaz. STEREO ta pa un fuente di liña.

column1: The whole gesture. This IS the cue's duration -- a sting is the one generated signal here that ends.
column2: Henter e gesto. Esaki TA e duracion di e cue -- un sting ta e unico señal genera aki cu ta caba.

column1: Click the value to send this fixture or leave it where the last cue put it. ~ makes the level breathe
column2: Click riba e balor pa manda e luz aki of laga'e unda ultimo cue a pon'e. ~ ta hasi e nivel hala rosea

column1: FDS is a wavetable bent by a modulator. 2A03 is the pulse/triangle/noise set most chiptune is made of.
column2: FDS ta un wavetable dobla pa un modulador. 2A03 ta e set di pulse/triangle/noise cu mayoria chiptune ta traha di dje.

column1: Scramble which glyph means which brightness. Same set, different handwriting. Seeded, so it stays put.
column2: Mezcla cua glyph ta nifica cua brio. Mesun set, otro letter. Cu semia, pesei e ta keda.

column1: Pixel sort: runs of pixels sorted by brightness within a row, which is what makes datamosh look melted.
column2: Pixel sort: rij di pixel ordena pa brio den un liña, esei ta pone datamosh parce derriti.

column1: How many cells the marks may climb. They thin out as they go, so a tall reach trails rather than doubles.
column2: Cuanto cel e marcanan por subi. Nan ta bira fini segun nan ta subi, pesei un alcance halto ta laga rastro en bes di dobla.

column1: cue act val  -  G take  S stop  F fade out (val = tenths of a second)  V volume  O opacity  J jump to row
column2: cue acc bal  -  G tuma  S para  F sali poco poco (bal = decimo di segundo)  V volumen  O opacidad  J bula na liña

column1: Harmonic weight: a pure chime at zero, brass at full. This is the difference between a ping and a fanfare.
column2: Peso harmonico: un klok puro na cero, brass na full. Esaki ta e diferencia entre un ping y un fanfara.

column1: Steps through the inputs this computer has. 'Settings input' follows the input chosen in Settings > Audio.
column2: Ta pasa e entradanan di e computer aki. 'Settings input' ta sigui e entrada scogi den Settings > Audio.

column1: Embers to roaring. It still surges and settles at any setting -- a fire that does not move reads as a photo
column2: For di carbon te candela grandi. E ta subi y baha na cualkier ahustamento -- candela cu no ta move ta parce un potret

column1: Reference pitch. 440 is modern standard, 432 the common alternative, and older instruments sat lower still.
column2: Toon di referencia. 440 ta e standard moderno, 432 e alternativa comun, y instrumento bieuw tabata mas abou ainda.

column1: Where the sting starts. Under a voice it wants to stay out of the way; over a room it wants to cut through.
column2: Unda e sting ta cuminsa. Bou di un stem e mester keda for di caminda; riba un sala e mester corta pasa.

column1: Digital gain on the input, -40 to +40 dB. Set the interface's own preamp first; this is for the last few dB.
column2: Ganancia digital riba e entrada, -40 te +40 dB. Pone preamp di e interfaz prome; esaki ta pa e ultimo pa dB.

column1: Pulse the size. On its own this moves width AND height together; give height its own ~ to squash and stretch
column2: Pulsa e tamaño. E so ta move ancho Y altura huntu; duna altura su mes ~ pa pusha y stira

column1: A card fills the frame; a Lower Third is a name and a role, low on a transparent frame, with an in and an out
column2: Un karta ta yena e imagen; un Lower Third ta un nomber y un rol, abou riba un imagen transparente, cu un drenta y un sali

column1: Held keeps the last displacement rather than removing it -- the picture stays bent the way the driver left it.
column2: Held ta tene e ultimo desplasamento en bes di kit'e -- e imagen ta keda dobla manera e driver a lag'e.

column1: 12.5 and 25 are thin and reedy, 50 is hollow. 75 sounds identical to 25 -- it is here because trackers expose it.
column2: 12.5 y 25 ta fini y nasal, 50 ta bashi. 75 ta zona igual cu 25 -- e ta aki pasobra trackers ta mustr'e.

column1: Quantise the output like the hardware. The steps ARE the sound; smoothing them makes it a synth imitating a chip.
column2: Cuantisa e salida manera e hardware. E pasonan TA e zonido; suavisa nan ta hasi'e un synth cu ta imita un chip.

column1: Moves every selected cue's trim by the same dB, keeping the differences between them; typing a value sets them all to it
column2: Ta move trim di tur cue scogi cu e mesun dB, ta tene e diferencia entre nan; tipa un balor ta pone nan tur na dje

column1: Where the playlist's crosspoints send it (Settings > Audio). Click to open the matrix by name, starting from exactly that
column2: Unda e puntonan di cruce di e playlist ta mand'e (Settings > Audio). Click pa habri e matrix pa nomber, cuminsando exacto for di e ruta ei

column1: name values with  d = ...;  end with one expression, or three for red green blue  |  Shift+Enter: new line  |  Enter: apply
column2: duna balor nomber cu  d = ...;  caba cu un expresion, of tres pa cora berde blauw  |  Shift+Enter: liña nobo  |  Enter: aplica

column1: Put back what it started from once the ramp lands (after the stop): a deck left ready for its next cue, a swell that lets go
column2: Pone bek loke tabata na cuminsamento ora e rampa yega (despues di para): un deck kla pa su siguiente cue, un subida cu ta laga bai

column1: Which speech model makes the captions: English, any language, or the slower, more accurate pair. Each is a one-time download
column2: Cua modelo di habla ta traha e subtitulonan: Ingles, cualkier idioma, of e pareja mas pocopoco y mas exacto. Cada un ta wordo descarga un biaha

column1: What the mask cuts: this cue wherever it plays, this playlist on the focused output, that output's whole picture, or its matte
column2: Loke e mascara ta corta: e cue aki unda cu e toca, e playlist aki riba e salida cu foco, henter imagen di e salida ei, of su matte

column1: Play at the screen's rate when it is within 0.2% (59.94 on 60): every frame shown once, the sound up to 3.5 cents sharp or flat
column2: Toca na velocidad di pantaya ora e ta den 0.2% (59.94 riba 60): cada imagen mustra un biaha, e zonido te 3.5 cent mas halto of mas abou

column1: Quarter turns are exact and stay crisp. Spinning samples at an angle, which tears pixel art -- sometimes that is what you want.
column2: Cuarto buelta ta exacto y ta keda claro. Draai ta tuma muestra na un angulo, cu ta skeur pixel art -- tin biaha esei ta loke bo kier.

column1: Every take starts the puppetry the same way, so a rehearsed look repeats instead of depending on how long the app has been open.
column2: Cada take ta cuminsa e movimento mesun manera, pa un aparencia ensaya repiti en bes di depende di cuanto tempo e app ta habri.

column1: What aims each tilt: its own position, the picture's luma gradient so characters lean the way the image does, or the cell's hue.
column2: Loke ta apunta cada inclinacion: su mes posicion, e gradiente di luma di e imagen pa e letternan inclina manera e imagen, of e tono di e cel.

column1: Name a channel or a pair once. Playlists send to the name, so a different interface means changing the names here, not every cue.
column2: Duna un canal of un pareja nomber un biaha. Playlistnan ta manda na e nomber, pesei un otro interfaz ta nifica cambia e nombernan aki, no cada cue.

column1: Click a crosspoint to walk it: off, 0, -3, -6, -12 dB. Drag it sideways for any level. A playlist with none plays to its own device.
column2: Click riba un punto di cruce pa cambi'e: paga, 0, -3, -6, -12 dB. Hal'e pa banda pa cualkier nivel. Un playlist sin ningun ta toca na su mes aparato.

column1: Sprite sets installed in data/sprites. Each folder there is a set; cycling picks one and wraps back to none. Right-click turns them off.
column2: Set di sprite instala den data/sprites. Cada carpeta ei ta un set; cambia ta scoge un y bai bek na ningun. Click drechi ta paga nan.

column1: Internal resolution, 1 chunkiest to 5 finest. This is an aesthetic control as much as a speed one -- the 8-bit look comes from big pixels.
column2: Resolucion interno, 1 mas grof te 5 mas fini. Esaki ta un control di estetica mesun tantu cu di velocidad -- e aparencia di 8-bit ta bin di pixel grandi.

column1: Picture takes colour from the image. Green, amber and cyan are terminal phosphors. Palette locks the text to the selected hardware palette.
column2: Picture ta tuma color di e imagen. Berde, amber y cyan ta fosforo di terminal. Palette ta pega e texto na e paleta di hardware scogi.

column1: SUBTLE self-heals (H.264). CLASSIC is the real smear (MPEG-4). EXTREME is chunkier and smears constantly. Changing this re-prepares the cue.
column2: SUBTLE ta cura su mes (H.264). CLASSIC ta e smeer berdadero (MPEG-4). EXTREME ta mas grof y ta smeer semper. Cambia esaki ta prepara e cue atrobe.

column1: Sine for line-up, pink to ring out a PA, white to find rattles, sweep to hear where a room rings, identify to walk the outputs one at a time.
column2: Sine pa ahusta, pink pa sintoniza un PA, white pa haya ratel, sweep pa tende unda un sala ta zona, identify pa pasa e salidanan un pa un.

column1: Which effect, by its place in the stack of the cue that deck is playing when this fires. With nothing there, the fade says so and does nothing
column2: Cua efecto, pa su lugar den e stapel di e cue cu e deck ei ta toca ora esaki cuminsa. Si no tin nada ei, e fade ta bisa esei y no ta hasi nada

column1: Each frame blended into the next. This is the Hypno signature -- at 0 it is a pattern generator, above it the picture starts feeding on itself.
column2: Cada imagen mezcla den esun siguiente. Esaki ta e firma di Hypno -- na 0 e ta un generador di patron, riba esei e imagen ta cuminsa come su mes.

column1: What is through the window on the hearth wall: a garden, rain, snow or the sea. A room with weather outside reads as somewhere rather than as a wall
column2: Loke tin pafo di e bentana riba e muraya di candela: un hardin, awa, sneeuw of laman. Un cuarto cu tempo pafo ta lesa como un lugar en bes di un muraya

column1: BY FIXTURE: the lights in the patch (Settings > Network > FIXTURES), by name. CHANNELS: channel=level by hand. A cue can carry both; channels go last
column2: PA LUZ: e luznan den e patch (Settings > Network > FIXTURES), pa nomber. CANALNAN: canal=nivel na man. Un cue por carga tur dos; canalnan ta bai ultimo

column1: Each character rocks as though it were a card being tilted. Every cell has its own phase, so the grid breathes instead of sliding about as one sheet.
column2: Cada letter ta slinger manera un karta cu ta inclina. Cada cel tin su mes fase, pesei e rooster ta hala rosea en bes di desliza manera un blachi.

column1: Pen: click for corners, drag for curves, click the first point to close (P). Points: drag, click the outline to add one, Alt-click or Delete to remove
column2: Pen: click pa skina, hala pa curva, click riba prome punto pa sera (P). Punto: hala, click riba e rand pa agrega un, Alt-click of Delete pa kita

column1: The chip's three channels. They differ in kind: triangle has no volume control on the hardware, and noise is a shift register rather than an oscillator.
column2: E tres canal di e chip. Nan ta diferente: triangle no tin control di volumen riba hardware, y noise ta un shift register en bes di un oscilador.

column1: Curated sets of symbols and emoji -- stars, notes, flowers, arrows, weather, runes, faces. Picking one fills the custom glyphs below, which stays editable.
column2: Set scogi di simbolo y emoji -- strea, nota, flor, flecha, tempo, runa, cara. Scoge un ta yena e glyphnan ariba, cu ta keda editabel.

column1: Play from the computer keyboard, Ableton layout: A W S E D F T G Y H U J, Z and X for octave. While this is ON those keys make notes instead of firing cues.
column2: Toca for di teclado di computer, layout di Ableton: A W S E D F T G Y H U J, Z y X pa octava. Mientras esaki ta ON e teclanan ei ta toca nota en bes di cuminsa cues.

column1: Deck opacity, deck volume, the master dimmer, the active cue's own brightness / contrast / saturation / hue, or a knob of one of its effects or audio effects
column2: Opacidad di deck, volumen di deck, e dimmer master, brio / contraste / saturacion / tono di e cue activo, of un boton di un di su efecto of efecto di zonido

column1: Scanlines, phosphor bloom and RGB fringing. The bloom is the part that matters -- a phosphor spills sideways, which is why a CRT looks like it is emitting light.
column2: Scanline, brio di fosforo y rand RGB. E brio ta loke ta conta -- un fosforo ta sparse pa banda, pesei un CRT ta parce cu e ta saca luz.

column1: Torn scanline bands and RGB separation. In text mode it also corrupts CELLS -- whole rows lock to one repeating character, the way a real text screen loses sync.
column2: Banda di scanline skeur y separacion RGB. Den modo di texto e ta daña CEL tambe -- henter liña ta pega riba un letter cu ta repiti, manera un pantaya di texto berdadero cu ta perde sincronisacion.

column1: Still holds the frame you are on. Flipbook plays the frames in turn. Replay draws the first frame stroke by stroke, the way it was drawn, then holds and starts again
column2: Still ta tene e imagen cu bo ta riba dje. Flipbook ta toca e imagennan un tras di otro. Replay ta pinta e prome imagen streep pa streep, manera e a wordo pinta, despues e ta tene y cuminsa atrobe

column1: Start, Stop, Pause, Resume, Load (stand it by without firing), Arm, Disarm, or Devamp it (a loop plays out its pass and ends); or Stop all, Pause all, Resume all: every deck
column2: Start, Stop, Pause, Resume, Load (prepar'e sin cuminsa), Arm, Disarm, of Devamp (un loop ta caba su buelta y para); of Stop all, Pause all, Resume all: tur deck

column1: Scope shows shape and clipping. Lissajous shows phase and polarity between the first two channels -- a diagonal the wrong way means one is inverted. Spectrum is third-octave bars.
column2: Scope ta mustra forma y clipping. Lissajous ta mustra fase y polaridad entre e prome dos canal -- un diagonal na e banda robes ta nifica cu un ta inverti. Spectrum ta barra di tercio di octava.

column1: 0 picks the glyph the brightness asks for, 1 picks any glyph in the set. Turn it up to see the whole alphabet: ranked strictly by ink, a flat area picks one mark and the rest never appear.
column2: 0 ta scoge e glyph cu e brio ta pidi, 1 ta scoge cualkier glyph den e set. Subi'e pa mira henter e alfabet: ordena stricto pa tinta, un area plat ta scoge un marca y e restu nunca ta parce.

column1: Blocks and dithers read as density; the ASCII ramp reads as text; symbols read as wreckage. Cycling this clears a custom glyph string, since that would override it -- the preset row puts one back.
column2: Blokki y dither ta lesa como densidad; e rampa ASCII ta lesa como texto; simbolonan ta lesa como restu. Cambia esaki ta kita un cadena di glyph propio, pasobra e lo pasa riba dje -- e liña di preset ta pone un bek.

column1: Equal temperament buys free modulation at the cost of every interval being slightly wrong. Just and pythagorean are exactly in tune in one key. Bohlen-Pierce divides a twelfth, so it has no octaves.
column2: Temperamento igual ta cumpra modulacion liber na costo di cada interval ta un tiki robes. Just y pythagoreano ta exacto afina den un tono. Bohlen-Pierce ta parti un duodecima, pesei e no tin octava.

column2: ORDER - cues ta bai abou den e lista

load a sprite sheet from a file...

column2: Bula e driver bek na su prome imagen

column2: Toca e movimento di sali awor, despues kit'e

column2: Kita e Lower Third activo awor

column2: e cue scogi den e playlist cu foco

column2: henter imagen di e salida ei, of su matte

column2: SHUFFLE - e siguiente cue ta wordo scogi na casualidad

column1: Ancient cypher, modern video desk. Respect.
column2: Codigo antiguo, mesa di video moderno. Respet.

column1: Ctrl+Shift+S - write the show to a NEW file
column2: Ctrl+Shift+S - skirbi e show den un archivo NOBO

column2: Ctrl+S - skirbi riba e show cu ta habri

Saludo, primitivo. Bo "slideshow" ta diberti nos.

column2: Loke e cue aki ta hasi ora e caba - click pa cambia

column1: LEARN: move a knob or press a key on the controller...
column2: LEARN: move un boton of primi un tecla riba e controlador...

column1: Per-cue audio: enable, trim, pan, mono, fades, normalize
column2: Zonido pa cada cue: encende, trim, pan, mono, fade, normalisa

column1: MIDI input is off: turn it on in MIDI CONTROL. OSC rows still answer.
column2: Entrada MIDI ta paga: pon'e den MIDI CONTROL. Liñanan OSC ta contesta ainda.

column1: --- -- --  does nothing on that playlist  -  (M) the step's own playlist
