column1: A stage timer over a picture, held, a presenter view for the person on stage, and a launch.
column2: Un timer di escenario riba un portret, un pousa, un vista pa e persona riba escenario, i un lansamento.

column1: A second playlist as a layer, TAKE ALL so two things change on one beat, and a playlist's opacity.
column2: Un di dos playlist como layer, TAKE ALL pa cambia dos cos den un golpi, i opacidad di un playlist.

column1: The fashion show, with Edda Mod
column2: E show di moda, cu Edda Mod
Control na tera, cu Major Tomasina

column1: Polly Carton's tour bus leaves at six, skapi, and this show goes with it. Press START.
column2: E bus di tour di Polly Carton ta sali seis or, skapi, i e show aki ta bai cu ne. Primi CUMINSA.

column1: A show that travels needs three things first: a check, a fix and a bundle.
column2: Un show cu ta biaha tin mester di tres cos prome: controla, drecha i paketa.

column1: Honey, I've played four thousand towns. Not one of them had my laptop.
column2: Dushi, mi a canta den cuater mil pueblo. Niun di nan tabatin mi laptop.

column1: It lists what the show would trip over: missing files, empty cues, outputs it cannot reach.
column2: E ta lista loke por stroba e show: file perdi, cue bashi, output cu e no por alcanza.

column1: Every show has a problem. Find yours before the audience does.
column2: Cada show tin un problema. Haña esun di bo prome cu publico.

column1: The intro video is on the office computer. Select it and delete it, or RELINK it if you have the file.
column2: E video di introduccion ta riba e computer di oficina. Cohe i kita e, of uza RELINK si bo tin e file.

column1: Fix it here, with time and coffee. Not at the venue, with neither.
column2: Drecha e aki, cu tempo i koffie. No na e luga di show, sin niun di dos.

column1: Leave it behind, sugar. I left a whole wig in Tulsa and the show went on.
column2: Laga e atras, dushi. Mi a laga un peluca completo na Tulsa i e show a sigui.

column1: Press BUNDLE and choose where: a USB stick, a shared folder. The show and all its media, in one folder.
column2: Primi PAKETA i scoge unda: un USB of un folder comparti. E show i tur su media den un folder.

column1: Pack it like a wig box. Everything inside, nothing loose.
column2: Paketa manera un caha di peluca. Tur cos paden, niun cabey los.

column1: Checked, fixed, bundled. On the other computer, open the show in the bundle and everything is there.
column2: Controla, drecha, paketa. Riba e otro computer, habri e show den e pakete i tur cos ta ei.

column1: The show file is only text, so it travels light. The media is the luggage.
column2: E file di show ta texto so, e ta biaha lihe. E media ta e maletanan.

column1: Bus leaves at six. Show starts at eight. Hair takes until seven.
column2: Bus ta sali seis or. Show ta cuminsa ocho or. Cabey ta tuma te siete or.

column1: There are dozens, and most of them run on the graphics card, so you can stack them.
column2: Tin docena, i mayoria ta core riba e carta grafico, p'esei bo por pone nan riba otro.

column1: An effect, a ~ and a colour. The critic is crying. Good crying, I think.
column2: Un efecto, un ~ i un color. E critico ta yora. Di felicidad, mi ta kere.

column1: Stack a few more. Order matters: each effect works on the picture the one above it made.
column2: Pone algun mas. Orden ta conta: cada efecto ta traha riba e portret cu esun riba dje a haci.

column1: Three effects! It's a mess! It's ALIVE! Post it.
column2: Tres efecto! Un caos! E ta BIBU! Publica e.

column1: Coach Marv has two minutes of airtime, one replay and a pen, skapi. He will use all three. Press START.
column2: Coach Marv tin dos minuut di transmision, un replay i un pen, skapi. E lo uza tur tres. Primi CUMINSA.

column1: Tonight: a test pattern, drawing on the picture, and the video synth.
column2: Awe nochi: un patron di prueba, dibuha riba e portret, i e synth di video.

column1: Folks, I've watched this play forty times. It's still a play.
column2: Hende, mi a mira e jugada aki cuarenta biaha. E ta un jugada ainda.

column1: PATTERN adds Pocket Test. If its circles are not round, a screen is stretched. Find out now, not on air.
column2: PATRON ta agrega Pocket Test. Si su sirculonan no ta rondo, un pantaya ta rek. Haña sa awor, no den transmision.

column1: Its bars and steps are checked against real meters, so a wrong screen looks wrong at once.
column2: Su baranan i pasonan ta controla cu medidor real, p'esei un pantaya robes ta mustra robes mesora.

column1: That's a test pattern. You test with it. That's why they call it that.
column2: Esei ta un patron di prueba. Bo ta prueba cu ne. P'esei nan ta yama e asina.

column1: Select The replay and TAKE it.
column2: Cohe The replay i primi TAKE.

column1: A replay loops, so the pundit can talk over it for as long as he likes. He likes.
column2: Un replay ta ripiti pa e experto por papia cuanto e ke. I e ke hopi.

column1: Here's number 22. Number 22 has the ball. That's important, because the ball is how you score.
column2: Ata number 22. Number 22 tin e bala. Esaki ta importante, pasobra cu bala bo ta scoor.

column1: The pen goes over the replay, on its own layer. Press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: E pen ta bai riba e replay, den su mes layer. Primi + na final di e tabnan di playlist.

column1: A second playlist is a layer over the first.
column2: Un di dos playlist ta un layer riba e prome.

column1: Over it. Not under it. Under it, you can't see it. That's football.
column2: Riba dje. No bou dje. Bou dje bo no ta mira e. Esei ta futbol.

column1: The lit tab is where SOURCE puts things. Skip this and the ink lands under the replay.
column2: E tab cu ta lombra ta caminda FUENTE ta pone cos. Salta esaki i e tinta ta keda bou e replay.

column1: See that tab? Click it. Fundamentals.
column2: Bo ta mira e tab? Click riba dje. Base.

column1: A Draw cue is clear wherever there is no ink, so the replay shows through.
column2: Un cue di DIBUHA ta transparente unda no tin tinta, p'esei bo ta mira e replay dor di dje.

column1: Give me the pen. I've waited all season for the pen.
column2: Duna mi e pen. Mi a warda henter temporada pa e pen.

column1: Both are live now: the replay underneath, the ink on top.
column2: Tur dos ta bibu awor: e replay bou, e tinta riba.

column1: We're on the air. Nobody touches the pen but me.
column2: Nos ta den transmision. Niun hende no ta toca e pen sino ami.
HACI UN SIRCULO ROND DI DJE

column1: Press DRAW in the inspector, then circle number 22 on the programme monitor. He is the yellow one.
column2: Primi DIBUHA den inspector, despues haci un sirculo rond di number 22 riba monitor di programa. Ta esun geel.

column1: A pen's pressure makes the line thicker. A mouse presses at one strength.
column2: Presion di pen ta haci e liña mas diki. Un mouse tin un solo fuerza.

column1: Circle him! The yellow one! There's only one yellow one. Circle that one.
column2: Rond di dje! Esun geel! Tin un geel so. Rond di esey!

column1: Draw as much as you like. Then SAVE STILL keeps the drawing as a picture with a clear background, in the playlist.
column2: Dibuha cuanto bo ke. Despues warda portret ta warda e dibuho como un portret cu fondo transparente den playlist.

column1: For next week's show. He will want that circle again.
column2: Pa e show di otro siman. E lo ke e sirculo atrobe.

column1: Put that in the Hall of Fame. Next to the turducken.
column2: Pone esey den sala di fama. Banda di e turducken.

column1: Halftime. Click the Deck 1 tab, then SOURCE, then Video Synth.
column2: Pausa. Click riba e tab Deck 1, despues FUENTE, despues Synth di video.

column1: My favourite source: oscillators, mirrors and feedback. A halftime show with no camera at all.
column2: Mi fuente favorito: oscillator, spiegel i feedback. Un show di pausa sin niun camera.

column1: Halftime! Somebody get me some lights. And a band. And a sandwich.
column2: Pausa! Un hende trese luz pa mi. I un banda. I un sandwich.

column1: Select the synth and TAKE it. Then look at the monitor: your ink is still up.
column2: Cohe e synth i primi TAKE. Mira e monitor: bo tinta ta ei ainda.

column1: Playlist 2 did not change, so its ink stays over whatever playlist 1 shows. Each playlist changes on its own.
column2: Playlist 2 no a cambia, p'esei su tinta ta keda riba loke playlist 1 ta mustra. Cada playlist ta cambia pa su cuenta.

column1: Leave the circle up. It's a good circle. It goes with everything.
column2: Laga e sirculo. Un bon sirculo. E ta pas cu tur cos.

column1: A test pattern, a replay, ink on a layer, a still, and halftime. That's the booth.
column2: Patron di prueba, replay, tinta riba un layer, portret fiho i pausa. Esei ta e cabina.

column1: Replay in the Draw section draws your lines back the way you drew them. He will love that.
column2: Replay den e seccion DIBUHA ta dibuha bo liñanan atrobe manera bo a haci. E lo gusta esey.

column1: Same time next week. Bring a bigger pen.
column2: Mismo ora otro siman. Trese un pen mas grandi.

column1: Now THAT is a busy play. I can't see the field. I love it.
column2: ESEY ta un jugada yen! Mi no ta mira e cancha. Mi ta stima e.

column1: Two projectors overlap, and each fades its edge so the overlap is not twice as bright. Watch the sides of the monitor go soft.
column2: Dos projector ta tapa un parti di otro, i cada un ta sua su rand pa e luz no dobla. Mira e bandanan di monitor bira suave.

column1: A game show, skapi. Three contestants, one buzzer, and a host who is not here tonight. Press START.
column2: Un show di pregunta, skapi. Tres participante, un buzzer, i un presentado cu no ta aki awe nochi. Primi CUMINSA.

column1: Cue numbers, hotkeys, and GO from other machines.
column2: Number di cue, tecla rapido, i GO for di otro maquina.

column1: Forty years I turned the letters. Tonight they gave me the microphone. Nobody panic.
column2: Cuarenta aña mi a bira letter. Awe nochi nan a duna mi e microfon. Ningun panico.

column1: Theatre numbers its cues: Q3, Q3.5, Q12A. Deckboy reads them all.
column2: Teatro ta number su cue: Q3, Q3.5, Q12A. Deckboy ta lesa tur.

column1: Numbers! I know letters. Numbers are letters that went to college.
column2: Number! Mi conoce letter. Number ta letter cu a bai universidad.

column1: GOTO crosses a long list faster than scrolling. Much faster.
column2: GOTO ta cruza un lista largo mas lihe cu scroll. Hopi mas lihe.

column1: F1 to F10, F12, or the number pad. Each one is a buzzer.
column2: F1 te F10, F12, of e teclado numerico. Cada un ta un buzzer.

column1: Every contestant gets a buzzer. I get the letters. It's fine. It's fine.
column2: Cada participante ta haya un buzzer. Mi ta haya e letternan. Ta bon. Ta bon.

column1: No mouse, no list, no looking. Only the key.
column2: Sin mouse, sin lista, sin wak. E tecla so.

column1: Buzz! A winner! I've never said that. I've only pointed at it.
column2: Bzz! Un ganador! Nunca mi a bisa esey. Mi a mustra e so.

column1: And for our viewers at home: yes, you can push the buttons too.
column2: I pa nos publico na cas: si, boso tambe por primi e botonnan.

column1: Numbers, GOTO, a buzzer, and GO from anywhere. You could host a game show now.
column2: Number, GOTO, un buzzer i GO for di tur caminda. Awor bo por presenta un show di pregunta.

column1: Goodnight, everybody! Tomorrow I go back to the letters. I'll miss you.
column2: Bon nochi, tur hende! Mañan mi ta bolbe na e letternan. Lo mi sinti falta di boso.

column1: And the number is... not three. I'll allow it. I turn anything.
column2: I e number ta... no tres. Mi ta acepta. Mi ta bira tur cos.

column1: A second playlist is a layer over the map. The lizard stays underneath. For now.
column2: Un di dos playlist ta un layer riba e mapa. E lagadishi ta keda bou. Pa awor.

column1: A Lower Third, a name, a title card, a backdrop. The lizard has left the studio.
column2: Un Lower Third, un nomber, un carchi di titulo, un fondo. E lagadishi a sali for di studio.

column1: That's not my name. It's a lovely name. Now, about that lizard...
column2: Esey no ta mi nomber. Un nomber bunita. Awor, tocante e lagadishi...

column1: A rocket built in a basement, skapi, an inventor who wants cheese, and a dog who does the real work. Press START.
column2: Un raket traha den kelder, skapi, un inventor cu ke keshi, i un cacho cu ta haci e trabao di berdad. Primi CUMINSA.

column1: Stage timers: a countdown over a picture, a hold, and a view for the person on stage.
column2: Timer di escenario: conta abou riba un portret, un pousa, i un vista pa e persona riba escenario.

column1: Playlist 2 is selected, over the rocket. SOURCE, then Stage Timer.
column2: Playlist 2 ta selecta, riba e raket. FUENTE, despues Stage Timer.

column1: *checks his watch, then the rocket, then his watch*
column2: *ta wak su oloshi, e raket, i su oloshi atrobe*

column1: Select the timer and TAKE it. I have cleared its backdrop, so the rocket shows behind the numbers.
column2: Cohe e timer i primi TAKE. Mi a kita su fondo pa e raket mustra atras di e numbernan.

column1: Past zero it keeps going and counts the overtime. Very honest. Slightly rude.
column2: Pasa cero e ta sigui conta e tempo extra. Masha honesto. Un tiki bruto.

column1: Close MENU, click the Deck 1 tab, then select 'The rocket (lift-off)' and TAKE it.
column2: Cera MENU, click riba e tab Deck 1, cohe 'The rocket (lift-off)' i primi TAKE.

column1: The clock is on playlist 2, so it stays up while the rocket changes underneath it.
column2: E oloshi ta riba playlist 2, p'esei e ta keda mientras e raket ta cambia bou dje.

column1: We have lift-off, Grommet! ...Grommet? Who's flying it?
column2: Nos a lanta, Grommet! ...Grommet? Ken ta stuur e?

column1: A countdown, a hold, a pilot's view and a launch. Bring crackers.
column2: Conta abou, pousa, vista di piloto i lansamento. Trese cracker.

column1: A magic show, skapi. A trunk, a rubber chicken, and one beat where everything changes at once. Press START.
column2: Un show di magia, skapi. Un caha, un galiña di rubber, i un golpi cu ta cambia tur cos huntu. Primi CUMINSA.

column1: Two playlists are two layers, and TAKE ALL changes both together. Tonight you will see why that matters.
column2: Dos playlist ta dos layer, i TAKE ALL ta cambia tur dos huntu. Awe nochi bo ta mira dicon esey ta conta.

column1: The chicken goes on its own layer. Press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: E galiña ta bai riba su mes layer. Primi + na final di e tabnan di playlist.

column1: The lit tab is the playlist that gets the next cue. Its chip now says 'to Out 1': it is layered over playlist 1 on that output.
column2: E tab cu ta lombra ta e playlist cu ta haya e siguiente cue. Su chip ta bisa 'pa Out 1': e ta riba playlist 1 na e output ey.

column1: Turnip Top has put the chicken in playlist 2. In playlist 1, TAKE 'The trunk (open)'. Then in playlist 2, TAKE the chicken.
column2: Turnip Top a pone e galiña den playlist 2. Den playlist 1, TAKE 'The trunk (open)'. Despues den playlist 2, TAKE e galiña.

column1: The chicken is clear all round, so it covers only itself. Watch the monitor between the two TAKEs.
column2: E galiña ta transparente rond di dje, p'esei e ta tapa su mes so. Mira e monitor entre e dos TAKE.

column1: Did you see it? For a moment the trunk was open and empty: two TAKEs are two moments. The trick is reset. Now select the open trunk in playlist 1 and the chicken in playlist 2, then TAKE ALL.
column2: Bo a mira? Un momento e caha tabata habri i bashi: dos TAKE ta dos momento. E truco ta cla atrobe. Cohe e caha habri den playlist 1 i e galiña den playlist 2, despues TAKE ALL.

column1: TAKE ALL takes every playlist's selected cue on one beat. No gap, no empty trunk.
column2: TAKE ALL ta lansa e cue selecta di cada playlist den un golpi. Sin espacio, sin caha bashi.

column1: The chicken was late. They saw an empty trunk. In magic we call that a trunk.
column2: E galiña tabata laat. Nan a mira un caha bashi. Den magia nos ta yama esey un caha.

column1: Trick two. Drag playlist 2's opacity fader down to nothing. The chicken fades away.
column2: Truco dos. Hala e fader di opacidad di playlist 2 abou te cero. E galiña ta desaparece suave.

column1: Every playlist has its own opacity. Down is a fade out, with no cue at all.
column2: Cada playlist tin su mes opacidad. Abou ta un fade out, sin niun cue.

column1: Ta-daaa! ...Hold for applause. Hold. Now watch it go.
column2: Ta-daaa! ...Warda pa aplauso. Warda. Awor mira e bai.

column1: Trick three. Bring it back: playlist 2's opacity all the way up.
column2: Truco tres. Trese bek: opacidad di playlist 2 henter ariba.

column1: Where did it go? Back in the trunk. Everything goes back in the trunk.
column2: Unda el a bai? Bek den e caha. Tur cos ta bolbe den e caha.

column1: An appearance done wrong, then right, a vanish and a return. Nazdrave.
column2: Un aparicion robes, despues bon, un desaparicion i un regreso. Nazdrave.

column1: A playlist can also sit on any output. Two layers, a great many tricks.
column2: Un playlist por sinta riba cualkier output tambe. Dos layer, hopi truco.

column1: It's back! Thank you! I'm here all week! The chicken is here forever.
column2: El a bolbe! Danki! Mi ta aki henter siman! E galiña ta aki pa semper!

column1: A cooking show, skapi. Live. The kitchen is on fire. Press START.
column2: Un show di cushina, skapi. Bibu. E cushina ta na candela. Primi CUMINSA.
Ta-da! Ainda ta cushina! ...Ainda ta kima.

column1: Bork! De fire extinguisher is also on fire!
column2: Bork! De extinguidor tambe ta na candela-flurdy!

column1: BLACK to hide, PANIC to stop, TAKE to come back. You will survive any kitchen.
column2: preto pa sconde, PANIC pa stop, TAKE pa bolbe. Bo lo sobrebibi cualkier cushina.

column1: A fashion show, skapi. One designer, one runway, and a look she will want back. Press START.
column2: Un show di moda, skapi. Un diseñador, un pasarela, i un look cu e lo ke bek. Primi CUMINSA.

column1: A preset stores a whole look and brings it back with one button.
column2: Un preset ta warda un look completo i ta trese bek cu un boton.

column1: Darling. A look is not a look until you can get it back.
column2: Dushi. Un look no ta un look te ora bo por trese bek.

column1: Buttons. Good. I design with buttons.
column2: Boton. Bon. Mi ta diseña cu boton.

column1: Store it. Before somebody has ideas.
column2: Warda e. Prome cu un hende haya idea.

column1: Close the DASH (Esc), then select Look two and TAKE it.
column2: Cera DASH (Esc), cohe Look two i primi TAKE.

column1: A cape. On my runway. Someone will trip, darling. Someone always trips.
column2: Un capa. Riba mi pasarela. Un hende lo struikel, dushi. Semper un hende ta struikel.

column1: Recall: the whole look comes back at once.
column2: Recall: e look completo ta bolbe mesora.

column1: Thank you. We will never speak of the cape again.
column2: Danki. Nunca mas nos ta papia di e capa.

column1: Simple. Timeless. Recallable. Now go, darling. I have a fitting.
column2: Simpel. Sin edad. Por trese bek. Bai dushi. Mi tin un prueba di paña.

column1: Pushes, wipes, iris, dip to white, and more. I wrote half of them. On a Tuesday.
column2: Push, wipe, iris, dip pa blanco i mas. Mi a scirbi mitar. Riba un diamars.

column1: A style, a time, and two very dramatic entrances. Roll credits.
column2: Un estilo, un tempo, i dos entrada masha dramatico. Core e creditonan.

column1: That is not an iris. ...It is better. I will allow it.
column2: Esey no ta un iris. ...E ta miho. Mi ta acepta.

column1: An effect, a bend and the patch. The robots approve, I think. Their faces are helmets.
column2: Un efecto, un bend i e patch. E robotnan ta aproba, mi ta kere. Nan cara ta helm.

column1: Waveform, vectorscope, false colour. The scopes settled it. The agents did not.
column2: Waveform, vectorscope, color falsu. E scopenan a disidi. E agentenan no.

column1: Major Tomasina is in orbit, skapi, and her picture has to reach the ground. Press START.
column2: Major Tomasina ta den orbita, skapi, i su portret mester yega tera. Primi CUMINSA.

column1: Pictures leave by cable or network: NDI, SDI from a DeckLink card, ST 2110 for broadcast plants.
column2: Portret ta sali via cabel of red: NDI, SDI for di un carta DeckLink, ST 2110 pa centro di transmision.

column1: Ground control, this is Major Tomasina. Can you see my picture?
column2: Control na tera, aki Major Tomasina. Boso ta mira mi portret?

column1: Every way down, on one page. Good. Space has very few cables.
column2: Tur caminda pa abou riba un pagina. Bon. Spacio tin masha poco cabel.

column1: Sending now. If nobody answers, I'll just float here.
column2: Mi ta manda awor. Si ningun hende contesta, mi ta keda flota aki.

column1: Ground control, signing off. Tell my mother I waved.
column2: Control na tera, mi ta cera. Bisa mi mama cu mi a zwaai.

column1: Ground control can see me! I can see my house from here.
column2: Control na tera por mira mi! Mi por mira mi cas for di aki.

column1: And one more window, showing the clock. Operators who watch a clock are never late.
column2: I un bentana mas pa e oloshi. Operador cu ta wak oloshi nunca ta laat.

column1: The big window is window one, which is usually the programme.
column2: E bentana grandi ta bentana un, normalmente e programa.

column1: Windows, the ... menu, NEXT, the clock, a layout, tally. Mystery solved.
column2: Bentana, e menu ..., NEXT, e oloshi, un layout, tally. Misterio resolvi.

column1: FX CHOICE: choice must be A or B
column2: FX CHOICE: e opcion mester ta A of B

column1: FX CHOICE: no effect at that index
column2: FX CHOICE: no tin efecto na e indice ey

column1: FX LFO: slot is A-D for the parameters, E for the amount, F and G for the fifth and sixth (or 0-6)
column2: FX LFO: slot ta A-D pa e parameternan, E pa e cantidad, F i G pa e di cinco i di seis (of 0-6)
